items.name: source-foundation
items.title: Source Foundation
items.description: Elattar Design System foundation: the four canonical stylesheets (tokens, typeset, motion, utilities), the globals.css entry, the tailwind-merge config, the stylesheet-driven spring/duration reader, and the Icon/IconSwap primitives every component depends on.
